biotools.summary: CytoPheno is a tool that automates the assignment of marker definitions and cell type names to unidentified clusters in flow and mass cytometry data. It utilizes per-marker calculations, standardization processes, and matching to Protein and Cell Ontologies, improving efficiency and reducing subjectivity in cell phenotyping.
